label: Blind sample 063: Hansen forest loss 2018, tile 00N_060W

verdict.headline: Can't tell
verdict.statement: Greenness (NDVI) fell by 0.05 relative to the control trajectory in the 18 months after 1 Jan 2018 (90% interval −0.15 to −0.02). The same test was run on 60 untouched control cells. In 43 of them the no-event prediction missed by as much after the event date, relative to how closely it matched before, as it did here (placebo p = 0.72). Counted by gap size instead, 1 of the 60 moved at least as far as this area did in the same direction (p = 0.03). But: only 10 clear observation periods before the event (need 20); the control trajectory does not track the area well enough before the event (pre-event error 0.04 vs typical 0.01).
